# Crypto Market Holds at $2.41T as Bitcoin Surges 4.99% Today

Shahzaib Ahmed

By  Shahzaib Ahmed

April 14, 2026 9:00 AM

Bitcoin News   Crypto Market News

Crypto Market Holds at $2.41T as Bitcoin Surges 4.99% Today

Share this article:

Share on Facebook   Share on Twitter   Share on Telegram   Share on LinkedIn

Table of contents [...] ## Bitcoin Surges by 4.99% and Ethereum Witnesses 8.05% Spike

The flagship crypto asset, Bitcoin ($BTC), is currently trading at $74,380.02. This price level denotes a 4.99% surge, while the market dominance of $BTC accounts for 58.8%. In addition to this, the leading altcoin, Ethereum ($ETH), is changing hands at $2,363.81, displaying an 8.05% increase. In the meantime, $ETH’s market dominance sits at 10.9%.

## $HBTC, $MAGA, and $TRUMP Dominate Daily Crypto Gainers [...] Apart from that, the list of today’s top crypto gainers includes Hold BTC ($HBTC), TRUMP MAGA ($MAGA), and TRUMP MOG ($TRUMP). Specifically, $HBTC has jumped by 766.29% to reach $0.000002358 in price. Subsequently, $MAGA is now hovering around $0.1424 after a 747.54% price rise. Following that, a 677.40% spike has placed $TRUMP’s price at $0.002733.
